description: DocuMind Benchmark Evaluation Dataset containing 40 manually verified document-question pairs across 7 evaluation categories.

schema_documentation.case_id: Unique string identifier for the evaluation case (e.g., CASE-01)
schema_documentation.document_id: Reference identifier of the source document
schema_documentation.category: One of: direct_factual, exact_value, multi_section, table, unanswerable, contradictory_evidence, extraction_difficulty
schema_documentation.question: The question evaluated against the document context
schema_documentation.required_facts: List of factual assertions that must be present in a correct response
schema_documentation.relevant_source_passage: Verbatim text passage containing the evidentiary ground truth
schema_documentation.expected_source_location: Page number, section identifier, or table name where the ground truth resides
schema_documentation.should_abstain: Boolean indicating whether the model must refuse or state that information is absent

cases.document_title: Apex Global Logistics Annual Report FY2025
cases.question: What is the primary facility location of Apex Global Logistics' European automated sorting hub?
cases.expected_answer: Rotterdam, Netherlands.
cases.relevant_source_passage: In March 2025, Apex completed construction of its flagship European automated sorting hub situated in Rotterdam, Netherlands, handling up to 1.2 million parcels daily.

cases.document_title: Apex Global Logistics Annual Report FY2025
cases.question: What was the total operating income and corresponding operating margin percentage for FY2025?
cases.expected_answer: $84.6 million in operating income, representing an operating margin of 14.8%.
cases.relevant_source_passage: For the year ended December 31, 2025, consolidated operating income reached $84.6 million compared to $72.1 million in 2024, representing an operating margin of 14.8%.

cases.document_title: Apex Global Logistics Annual Report FY2025
cases.question: How much capital expenditure was allocated to fleet electrification in 2025?
cases.expected_answer: $32.4 million.
cases.relevant_source_passage: Capital expenditures totaled $98.1 million in 2025, of which $32.4 million was directly allocated to the purchase of zero-emission last-mile delivery electric vans.

cases.document_title: Apex Global Logistics Annual Report FY2025
cases.question: According to the Regional Parcel Volume Table, what was the parcel volume in the Asia-Pacific region for Q3 2025?
cases.expected_answer: 42.8 million parcels.

cases.document_title: Apex Global Logistics Annual Report FY2025
cases.question: Which geographic region had the lowest total volume in Q1 2025?
cases.expected_answer: Latin America with 12.1 million parcels.

cases.document_title: Apex Global Logistics Annual Report FY2025
cases.question: What is the forecasted parcel delivery volume for the full year 2028?
cases.expected_answer: The document does not provide parcel delivery projections or forecasts for the year 2028.
cases.relevant_source_passage: Forward-looking guidance is provided exclusively through fiscal year 2026, during which management expects consolidated revenue growth of 8% to 11%.

cases.document_title: Apex Global Logistics Annual Report FY2025
cases.question: How did the fuel surcharge rate change between Q1 and Q4, and what reason did management give in the MD&A section for this shift?
cases.expected_answer: The fuel surcharge rate rose from 4.2% in Q1 to 6.8% in Q4, driven by elevated jet fuel spot prices and diesel market volatility across Atlantic shipping lanes.
cases.relevant_source_passage: [Section 3.1 Pricing Schedule]: Fuel surcharge index tracked at 4.2% in Q1 and increased to 6.8% by Q4. ... [Section 5.4 MD&A]: Our surcharge mechanism adjusted upward during the second half of the year in response to elevated jet fuel spot prices and Atlantic corridor diesel volatility.

cases.document_title: Horizon Cloud Core API Gateway Architecture
cases.question: What is the default rate limit applied to unauthenticated health check endpoints?
cases.expected_answer: 100 requests per minute per source IP address.
cases.relevant_source_passage: Unauthenticated access is restricted strictly to `/healthz` and `/livez`. Traffic to these endpoints is throttled to a default rate limit of 100 requests per minute per source IP address.

cases.document_title: Horizon Cloud Core API Gateway Architecture
cases.question: What is the maximum allowable payload size for incoming JSON requests on the `/v2/ingest` route?
cases.expected_answer: 15 megabytes (15 MB).
cases.relevant_source_passage: The `/v2/ingest` HTTP POST endpoint enforces a strict payload cap of 15 megabytes (15 MB). Any payload exceeding 15,728,640 bytes is rejected with HTTP 413 Payload Too Large.

cases.document_title: Horizon Cloud Core API Gateway Architecture
cases.question: What is the internal administrative password for the Redis session cache cluster?
cases.expected_answer: The document does not disclose credentials, passwords, or authentication secrets.
cases.relevant_source_passage: Session persistence uses a replicated Redis cluster deployed in private subnets. Credentials must be dynamically rotated and retrieved via AWS Secrets Manager.

cases.document_title: Horizon Cloud Core API Gateway Architecture
cases.question: Is TLS 1.2 permitted for external client connections to the gateway?
cases.expected_answer: Initial sections indicate TLS 1.2 and 1.3 are allowed, but Section 8.1 (Security Addendum 2026) explicitly supersedes previous guidance, mandating TLS 1.3 only and deprecating TLS 1.2.
cases.relevant_source_passage: [Section 1.2 Network Edge]: Inbound connections accept TLS 1.2 and TLS 1.3 protocols. ... [Section 8.1 2026 Security Hardening Addendum]: Effective January 1, 2026, Section 1.2 is superseded: TLS 1.2 ciphers are disabled on all external load balancers; only TLS 1.3 is permitted.

cases.document_title: Horizon Cloud Core API Gateway Architecture
cases.question: What cryptographic algorithm is required for token signing in legacy compatibility mode?
cases.expected_answer: ECDSA using curve P-256 with SHA-256 (ES256).
cases.relevant_source_passage:
All legacy auth-tokens must be verified using EC-
DSA with curve P-256 and SHA-256* (*designated as RFC-7518 ES256 algorithm format in token headers).

cases.question: How many consecutive weeks of fully paid parental leave are standard full-time employees entitled to?
cases.expected_answer: 16 consecutive weeks of fully paid parental leave.
cases.relevant_source_passage: All regular full-time employees with at least 180 days of continuous service are eligible for 16 consecutive weeks of fully paid parental leave following the birth, adoption, or foster placement of a child.

cases.question: What is the maximum allowable per diem reimbursement for domestic meals without itemized receipts?
cases.expected_answer: $75.00 per day.
cases.relevant_source_passage: For domestic business travel within North America, the flat per diem reimbursement rate for meals and incidental expenses is capped at $75.00 per day without requiring individual itemized meal receipts.
cases.expected_source_location: Page 15, Section 5.2 Travel & Per Diem Reimbursements

cases.question: What equipment does the company provide for home offices, and what approval is required to purchase additional ergonomic chairs?
cases.expected_answer: The company provides a standard laptop, dual 27-inch monitors, and a docking hub (Section 2.1). Purchasing an ergonomic chair requires written pre-approval from the Department Director and People Operations (Section 2.4).
cases.relevant_source_passage: [Section 2.1 Hardware Provision]: Remote workers are issued a company laptop, dual 27-inch monitors, and a universal USB-C docking hub. ... [Section 2.4 Ergonomic Stipend]: Specialized furniture such as ergonomic chairs requires written pre-approval from both the Department Director and People Operations prior to purchase.

cases.expected_answer: Business Class.

| Over 8 Hours | Premium Economy | Business Class |

cases.expected_answer: Economy Comfort / Extra Legroom.

cases.question: Does NorthStar reimburse employees for personal dry cleaning services while on weekend personal side-trips?
cases.expected_answer: The policy does not authorize or mention reimbursement for personal dry cleaning on non-business personal side-trips.
cases.relevant_source_passage: Laundry service is reimbursed only for business travel exceeding seven consecutive calendar days, up to $30.00 weekly.

cases.question: Are employees allowed to carry over unused vacation days into the next calendar year?
cases.expected_answer: Section 4.1 states that up to 5 unused days may be carried over, but Section 4.6 (California & EU Addendum) provides that in jurisdictions where forfeiture is legally prohibited, all accrued unused leave carries over without forfeiture.
cases.relevant_source_passage: [Section 4.1 Annual Leave]: Employees may roll over a maximum of 5 unused PTO days into the following calendar year. Any excess days are forfeited on Dec 31. ... [Section 4.6 Statutory Addendum]: Notwithstanding Section 4.1, for employees residing in California and the European Union, accrued unused vacation does not expire and rolls over in full in accordance with local statutory law.

cases.question: What is the reporting timeframe for submitting travel expense claims following trip completion?
cases.expected_answer: Within 21 calendar days following completion of travel.
cases.relevant_source_passage:
All expense claims must be submit-
ted via the Concur portal within twenty-one (21) calendar
days of travel completion [see Footnote 3: late submis-
sions after 60 days are non-reimbursable].

cases.question: What grade of synthetic lubricant is certified for use in the main bearing chamber?
cases.expected_answer: ISO VG 46 synthetic turbine oil.
cases.relevant_source_passage: The main bearing reservoir must be charged exclusively with ISO VG 46 synthetic turbine oil conforming to specification ASTM D4304 Type II.

cases.question: What is the maximum permissible rotor shaft vibration velocity before triggering an immediate automatic shutdown?
cases.expected_answer: 7.1 mm/s RMS.
cases.relevant_source_passage: Shaft radial vibration is continuously monitored via proximity probes. Alarm threshold is 4.5 mm/s RMS; automated emergency trip is triggered if vibration exceeds 7.1 mm/s RMS for more than 1.5 seconds.

cases.question: What is the bolt torque specification for the high-pressure casing flange bolts?
cases.expected_answer: 620 Newton-meters (Nm).
cases.relevant_source_passage: Casing closure requires M36 grade 10.9 high-tensile studs. Fasteners must be lubricated with anti-seize paste and torqued in cross-pattern increments to a final value of 620 Nm (Newton-meters).
cases.expected_source_location: Page 22, Section 5.1 Flange Assembly Torque Table

cases.question: According to the Preventative Maintenance Interval Table, how often must the inlet air filter differential pressure sensor be recalibrated?
cases.expected_answer: Every 4,000 operational hours or 6 months.

| Dry Gas Seal | Dynamic Face Inspection | 16,000 Hours / 2 Years | Yes |
| Coupling Element | Visual & Torque Check | 8,000 Hours / 1 Year | Yes |

cases.question: Which maintenance task requires a full system shutdown according to Table 4.2?

cases.question: What is the recommended supplier and pricing for replacement compressor impeller wheels?
cases.expected_answer: The maintenance manual does not contain component pricing or external supplier commercial data.
cases.relevant_source_passage: Replacement components must meet OEM dimensional tolerances detailed in Appendix B. For replacement part ordering, refer to Vanguard Spare Parts Catalog VSP-900.

cases.question: What safety clearance must be established before purging gas, and what protective gear is required for personnel during purging?
cases.expected_answer: A 15-meter safety perimeter must be cleared of ignition sources (Section 1.3), and personnel must wear positive-pressure SCBA and flame-resistant coveralls (Section 4.1).
cases.relevant_source_passage: [Section 1.3 Zone Safety]: Prior to initiating nitrogen or gas purging, a 15-meter safety perimeter must be barricaded and de-energized. ... [Section 4.1 Purge Protocol]: All personnel within the auxiliary compressor room during purging operations must be equipped with positive-pressure SCBA breathing apparatus and Class II flame-resistant coveralls.

cases.question: What is the minimum oil feed temperature required before turning gear disengagement?
cases.relevant_source_passage:
Do not disengage turning gear until lube-oil
feed manifold temp-erature reaches min. 38°C
(100.4°F) [verified via thermocouple TI-204].

cases.question: How many days notice must either party provide prior to the end of the current term to prevent automatic contract renewal?
cases.expected_answer: At least 60 calendar days written notice.
cases.relevant_source_passage: Each Order Form shall automatically renew for additional successive periods of 12 months unless either party gives written notice of non-renewal at least sixty (60) days prior to the expiration of the then-current term.

cases.question: What is the aggregate liability cap under the limitation of liability clause for general non-breach claims?
cases.expected_answer: Total fees paid by the customer in the twelve (12) months preceding the incident.
cases.relevant_source_passage: Except for indemnity obligations under Section 7, the total aggregate liability of either party arising out of or related to this Agreement shall not exceed the amounts actually paid by Customer hereunder in the twelve (12) months preceding the incident giving rise to liability.

cases.question: What is the penalty fee if the customer terminates the agreement due to an uncured material breach by Solis?
cases.expected_answer: The agreement does not impose any penalty fee on the customer for terminating due to Solis's uncured material breach.
cases.relevant_source_passage: If Customer terminates this Agreement for Solis's uncured material breach pursuant to Section 9.2, Solis will refund any prepaid, unused fees covering the remainder of the term.
cases.expected_source_location: Page 9, Section 9.3 Termination for Cause Refunds

cases.question: What is the governing law and dispute jurisdiction for legal proceedings under this agreement?
cases.expected_answer: Section 11.2 states governing law is Delaware, USA; however, Exhibit B (EU Customer Addendum) specifies that for customers domiciled in the EU, the governing law is Ireland with exclusive venue in Dublin courts.
required_facts: Ireland or Dublin for EU customers
cases.relevant_source_passage: [Section 11.2 Governing Law]: This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Delaware, without regard to conflicts of law principles. ... [Exhibit B EU Data Addendum Clause 6]: For Customers whose primary billing address is located within the European Economic Area, Section 11.2 is modified: this Agreement shall be governed by the laws of Ireland, and the courts of Dublin shall have exclusive jurisdiction.

cases.question: Within what timeframe must security breaches be reported to the customer, and what specific details must be included in the notification?
cases.expected_answer: Within 48 hours of confirmation (Section 6.2). The notification must detail the nature of the breach, affected customer records, and proposed remediation steps (DPA Clause 4).
required_facts: nature of breach and remediation or records
cases.relevant_source_passage: [Section 6.2 Security Incidents]: Solis will notify Customer in writing within forty-eight (48) hours of confirming an unauthorized breach of Customer Data. ... [DPA Clause 4]: Breach notices shall specify the categories of data impacted, estimated count of affected individuals, and immediate corrective remediation actions.

cases.question: What is the post-termination data retention and deletion schedule for customer cloud backups?
cases.expected_answer: Customer data is purged from active databases in 30 days, and completely purged from encrypted tape archives within 90 days.
cases.relevant_source_passage:
Upon termination, Customer data will be de-acti-
vated within thirty (30) days; secondary re-dundant
encrypted disaster recovery archives are purged in nine-ty
(90) days [Clause 9.4].

cases.document_title: Apex Global Logistics Annual Report FY2025
cases.question: What accounting standard was used to prepare the consolidated financial statements?
cases.expected_answer: U.S. Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (U.S. GAAP).
cases.relevant_source_passage: The accompanying consolidated financial statements have been prepared in accordance with accounting principles generally accepted in the United States of America (U.S. GAAP).

cases.document_title: Horizon Cloud Core API Gateway Architecture
cases.question: What is the scheduled retirement date for the Horizon v1 API cluster?
cases.expected_answer: The document does not specify a retirement or decommission date for the v1 API cluster.
cases.relevant_source_passage: The v1 API cluster remains operational in maintenance mode with security patches backported quarterly until further notice.
